title: A* Heuristic Derby
tagline: Visualize how different admissible heuristics trade search effort versus solution quality across increasing grid sizes.

curves.label: Uniform-Cost (h=0)
curves.code: function expandUniformCost(start, goal){ let open=[start]; let best=new Map([[key(start),0]]); while(open.length){ open.sort((a,b)=>a.g-b.g); let v=open.shift(); if(v===goal)return; for(let nb of neighbors(v)){ let ng=v.g+1; if(!best.has(key(nb))||ng<best.get(key(nb))){best.set(key(nb),ng); open.push({pos:nb,g:ng});}}}}
curves.name: Uniform-Cost (h=0)

curves.label: Manhattan (4-neigh)
curves.code: function expandAStarManhattan(start, goal){ let open=[{pos:start,g:0,h:manhattan(start,goal)}]; let bestG=new Map([[key(start),0]]); while(open.length){ open.sort((a,b)=>(a.g+a.h)-(b.g+b.h)); let cur=open.shift(); if(cur.pos===goal)return; for(let nb of neighbors4(cur.pos)){ let ng=cur.g+1; if(!bestG.has(key(nb))||ng<bestG.get(key(nb))){bestG.set(key(nb),ng); open.push({pos:nb,g:ng,h:manhattan(nb,goal)});}}}}
curves.name: Manhattan (4-neigh)

curves.label: Octile (8-neigh)
curves.code: function expandAStarOctile(start, goal){ let open=[{pos:start,g:0,h:octile(start,goal)}]; let bestG=new Map([[key(start),0]]); while(open.length){ open.sort((a,b)=>(a.g+a.h)-(b.g+b.h)); let cur=open.shift(); if(cur.pos===goal)return; for(let nb of neighbors8(cur.pos)){ let step=diagonalOrStraight(cur.pos,nb); let ng=cur.g+step; if(!bestG.has(key(nb))||ng<bestG.get(key(nb))){bestG.set(key(nb),ng); open.push({pos:nb,g:ng,h:octile(nb,goal)});}}}}
curves.name: Octile (8-neigh)

curves.label: Landmark ALT (k=4)
curves.code: function expandALT(start, goal, landmarks){ let open=[{pos:start,g:0,h:altHeuristic(start,goal,landmarks)}]; let bestG=new Map([[key(start),0]]); while(open.length){ open.sort((a,b)=>(a.g+a.h)-(b.g+b.h)); let cur=open.shift(); if(cur.pos===goal)return; for(let nb of neighbors4(cur.pos)){ let ng=cur.g+1; if(!bestG.has(key(nb))||ng<bestG.get(key(nb))){bestG.set(key(nb),ng); open.push({pos:nb,g:ng,h:altHeuristic(nb,goal,landmarks)});}}}}
curves.name: Landmark ALT (k=4)

curves.label: Perfect Oracle (h*)
curves.code: function expandOracle(start, goal, hStar){ let open=[{pos:start,g:0,h:hStar(start,goal)}]; let seen=new Set(); while(open.length){ open.sort((a,b)=>(a.g+a.h)-(b.g+b.h)); let cur=open.shift(); if(cur.pos===goal)return; seen.add(key(cur.pos)); for(let nb of neighbors(cur.pos)){ if(seen.has(key(nb))) continue; let ng=cur.g+stepCost(cur.pos,nb); open.push({pos:nb,g:ng,h:hStar(nb,goal)}); }}}
curves.name: Perfect Oracle (h*)
